text:
Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can paint pictures, compose music, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by these creations, while others worry that machines might replace human artists.

However, there is a key difference between human and machine creativity. AI learns from patterns in existing data, so it can imitate styles but doesn't truly understand emotions or experiences. A human painter uses personal memories, feelings, and imagination to create something new. A composer writes music that reflects joy, sadness, or struggle.

Instead of replacing us, AI can be a helpful tool. It can inspire artists, suggest fresh ideas, or save time on technical tasks. True creativity—with meaning and emotion—remains uniquely human.
